title: fix(spec): the permission-set form's Name help says when the name is filled from the label, and when to type it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSN3dVT8Lzd6qoG8RSVGvMt)_

Fixes #28180

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新建权限集表单里 API 名称（Name）的提示改为同时说明两种情况：显示名称里有拉丁字母或数字时自动填写，没有时（例如全中文、全日文）请自己输入；中、日、西三种语言的译文同步改。
- 为什么改：Console 只用显示名称里的拉丁字母和数字生成 Name，中文或日文名称生成的是空值；旧提示却说“由显示名称自动生成”，中文和日文用户看到的是一个空的必填框配一句“已自动生成”。
- 风险与回滚：只改提示文字，表单结构、Schema、生成逻辑都不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts（Identity 区 name 行）、packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts（permission.fields.name）、packages/spec/src/security/permission-form-label-first.test.ts。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/security/permission-form-label-first.test.ts`，预期 6 个用例全绿；或在中文界面的 Console 新建权限集，Name 下的提示说明全中文名称需手动输入。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The Console's create form fills a new permission set's `name` from the label through `slugify`, which keeps only `[a-z0-9]` after NFKD normalisation (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/createDerive.ts`, wired for `permission` in `anchors.ts` with `untilUserEdits`). A label written all in Chinese or Japanese therefore fills nothing. The `name` help said "Derived from the label when you create the set; snake_case", so a zh-CN or ja-JP admin saw an empty, required Name under a hint that said it had been filled.

- `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts`: the `name` help now names both outcomes: "Filled in from the label's Latin letters and digits when you create the set; if the label has none, type it yourself. snake_case". The comment above the rows records why.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: `en` follows the source (regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, which left the tree unchanged against the committed text); the hand-written zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values say the same two cases. Metadata-form leaves carry no source-hash entry, so no hash table moves.
- Measured: no other `*.form.ts` `name` help makes the "derived from the label" promise (the other `name` rows say only `snake_case` / unique identifier), so this is the only row.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/security/permission-form-label-first.test.ts`: the help case now asserts the help says the name comes from the label, says to type it otherwise, and still says `snake_case`; a control asserts the unconditional "derived from the label" wording is gone.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, per triage (6527260428):** a prompt next to Name on the Console create form when the derivation comes back empty, which `createDerive.ts` assumes exists. That is a `ui/` change and its own p3 card; the seat carries it.
- The same empty derivation applies to every other type wired with `slugify` in `anchors.ts` (flow, action, dashboard, report, object, page, view, hook, and doc in `default-schemas.ts`). None of their `name` helps promises a fill, so none is misleading; the Console prompt above would cover them all.
